font_family_recommendations.name: The Modern Tech Standard (Recommended)
font_family_recommendations.display: Geist Sans (or Instrument Sans for Marketing)
font_family_recommendations.reasoning: Geist is highly engineered for readability at both micro and macro scales, reminiscent of Vercel and Linear. It naturally handles high data density beautifully, has tabular features, and zero cost (OFL).

font_family_recommendations.name: The Premium Fintech
font_family_recommendations.reasoning: This mimics the ultra-refined Stripe/Ramp aesthetic. Extremely neutral but undeniably premium. Requires a paid license.

font_family_recommendations.name: Refine Current Stack
font_family_recommendations.reasoning: Easiest migration. Manrope is highly legible but the current implementation uses font-weight 500 for regular text. Dropping body weight to 400, adjusting line-heights, and enabling optical sizing/tabular figures will instantly fix the 'muddy' feel.

weight_strategy.regular: 400 (Crucial fix: Drop from current 500 to 400 for all body text to reduce visual muddiness)
weight_strategy.medium: 500 (Use only for secondary emphasis, small labels, or table headers)
weight_strategy.semibold: 600 (Use for primary buttons, KPI values, and subheadings h4-h6)
weight_strategy.bold: 700 (Use for dashboard h1-h3 and marketing h2-h3)

finance_specific_rules.tabular_numerals: Apply `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` (Tailwind `.tabular-nums`) to ALL currency amounts, timers, table columns containing numbers, and KPI values. This ensures vertical alignment.
finance_specific_rules.crypto_addresses: Use the Mono font. Truncate mid-string for UI display (e.g., `0x1234...abcd`) rather than wrapping long addresses. Provide a one-click copy button next to it.
finance_specific_rules.long_decimals: For crypto with 6-8 decimals, visually de-emphasize the trailing zeros or decimals if insignificant. E.g. `1.234567 BTC`.

implementation_notes.font_loading: If using Next.js/React, move away from `<link>` tags in document.js and utilize standard bundler imports for local fonts or `@fontsource` to prevent FOUT (Flash of Unstyled Text) and CLS. Keep fonts in `/public/fonts` but import them cleanly.
implementation_notes.theme_consolidation: Consolidate `theme.js`, `theme2.js`, `homeTheme.js`, `homeBento.js`, and `authTheme.js` into a single source of truth (e.g., `theme.config.js` or via standard CSS variables in `globals.css` that Shadcn/MUI can consume).
implementation_notes.css_variables: Map typography into structural CSS variables: `--font-sans`, `--font-mono`, `--font-display` to allow easy swapping.
implementation_notes.file_type_constraint: Note: Use `.js` or `.jsx` configurations as per project strict requirements (no `.tsx`).

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl with bg-white/70 (light) or bg-black/60 (dark) + 1px border. CRITICAL: Never use a fully transparent background for headers, sticky navs, or dropdowns. Always apply solid or glass backing.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Rely on crisp, subtle layered ambient shadows over flat dark borders for light mode. Dark mode should use 1px inner-white/10 borders instead of shadows.
visual_enhancers.borders: Limit border radiuses to max 8px for dashboards (tight, technical) and up to 16px for marketing cards.

grids.marketing: Bento Grid protocol. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 with gap-8 to gap-12. High asymmetry.
grids.dashboard: High-density Grid. Tight gap-4 or gap-6. Every pixel utilized, stretch children to match heights.

layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy (Tailwind scale p-4 to p-12). Ensure internal padding prevents text collision with borders.

accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="login-submit-button"`).
accessibility.contrast: Adhere strictly to minimum 4.5:1 for body text (WCAG AA). Hover/Focus states MUST explicitly set text color and ensure higher contrast.

instructions_to_main_agent.action: This is a SPEC-ONLY file generated per user instructions. Do NOT blindly execute code replacement without explicit user confirmation of the chosen font stack.
instructions_to_main_agent.priority: Adopt the `finance_specific_rules` and `accessibility` guidelines strictly when modifying components.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic 'AI slop' aesthetics. Do not use centered alignments globally or simplistic gradient backgrounds.
NEVER use fully transparent backgrounds on elements that overlap content (e.g., Navs, Headers, Dropdowns).
For icons: Use `lucide-react`, `@phosphor-icons/react` or `@heroicons/react`. DO NOT use emojis as UI icons.
Ensure hover states explicitly manage both `bg` and `text` colors.
DO NOT use 'Space Grotesk' for dashboard typography.
DO NOT use teal (#1B93A4) for dashboards.
